memories.title: Angular 4 templateUrl resolves relative to index.html, not component file
memories.text: In Angular 4 with SystemJS (no CLI, no webpack), templateUrl paths are resolved relative to the serving root (where index.html is), not the component file location. So a component in src/app/pages/home/home.ts with templateUrl: "views/pages/home.html" works because views/ is a sibling of index.html in src/. This means you can safely edit .html template files without recompiling TypeScript.
